subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• By adjusting their wing angles, birds can navigate complex wind currents during flight.
• In 2019, Yara Issa was inspired by bird flight mechanics to design adaptive aircraft wings.
• Over the course of two years, she designed, modeled, tested, and perfected her wing system.
• Each wing segment is equipped with sensors that detect changes in wind pressure.
• The sensors trigger automatic adjustments to the wing's angle and curvature to maintain optimal flight stability.
prompt: The student wants to begin a narrative about the creation of the wing system. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: When Yara Issa's wing system encounters changing wind pressure, sensors automatically adjust the wing's angle and curvature to maintain flight stability.
choices.B: After two years, Yara Issa had designed, modeled, tested, and perfected her adaptive wing system.
choices.C: Birds, which have inspired aircraft design, navigate complex wind currents by adjusting their wing angles.
choices.D: Inspired by birds, which navigate wind currents by adjusting their wing angles, Yara Issa set out to design aircraft wings capable of similar adaptive behavior.

explanation:
Choice D is the best answer. The sentence effectively begins a narrative about the creation of the wing system, explaining that birds' wind navigation technique inspired Yara Issa to "set out to design" aircraft wings that could adapt in a similar manner.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect. The sentence describes how the wing system responds to wind pressure; it doesn't effectively begin a narrative about the creation of the wing system.
